_truths: TRUTHS is seeded here because ch6 no longer recomputes it. ch3_whispers writes it (ch3.js:443) and ch8 reads it; ch6 used to keep a third copy of the laundry truth map and OVERWRITE ch3's value with it, which could only ever go stale. This script starts at ch6_start, so it has to seed it the way it already seeds WHISPER_*.
_ladders: The three reaction rounds ship NO hint ladder (R10.26, and ch7_binding's precedent). The ladder could not be opened without losing the round, nothing announced it, and round three's last rung named the partition's cardinality, which is the one fact that lets a page-less lane pass. The assert below is what stops one growing back.
_auto: the eval below is an auto-ringer: it presses a lane's key when a GOLD orb crosses the strike line. It must skip .orb.mimic — those are the Cold, and ringing one is a miss.

steps.expect: You are standing on a lid
nothing holds it but the old pattern
Pale blue lights are the Cold

steps.eval: (() => { const KEYS=['a','c','m','/']; if (window.__auto) clearInterval(window.__auto); window.__auto = setInterval(() => { document.querySelectorAll('#widget .lane').forEach((lane, i) => { const hy = lane.clientHeight - 58; lane.querySelectorAll('.orb:not(.mimic)').forEach(o => { if (o.__hit) return; const y = parseFloat(o.style.top) + 23; if (Math.abs(y - hy) < 22) { o.__hit = true; window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: KEYS[i], code: 'Key' + KEYS[i].toUpperCase(), bubbles: true })); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { key: KEYS[i], bubbles: true })); } }); }); }, 25); return 'auto-ringer on'; })()

steps._note: the dark round has no chords, so it builds no chain. There used to be a CSS rule hiding one; it could never fire. This is the assert that replaces it -- put a brace in ROUND3 and the suite says so.
hideScore, pinned. It does not keep a secret -- reaction.js paints the lane green or red per event whatever this says -- but it must not silently flip back on.
deadLanes:[1] in the dark round LABELS the Listener's lane. ROUND3 has no Voice event, so nothing can be gained by pressing it; what the flag buys is the word 'silent' on the lane.
